charts.title: K2-352 d: orbits around K2-352
charts.description: The orbits of K2-352's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-352 d highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: de Leon et al. 2021 (2021MNRAS.508..195D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname DE_LEON_ET_AL_2021): P 14.871387 d

charts.title: K2-352 d: its transit
charts.description: K2-352 d crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (45, 46, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 86130229, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 94 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 479 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 17-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 94 min early; 17-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 160 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
